rules: Raw sweep execution is diagnostic input, not acceptance by itself.
PASS requires an overall CALIBRATED runner record bound to the same current runner/spec authorities.
PASS requires exact-candidate visual captures for every named sweep sample and every required plan camera.
Contact-bearing sweeps require candidate-bound contact/load evidence; NOT_APPLICABLE is invalid for them.
Continuity and reversibility require explicit reviewed candidate-bound evidence.
Human-evidence review must cover the sweep plan evidence IDs.
Engineering PASS never implies owner acceptance or production approval.
